newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota to launch Camry Gracia in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Toyota to launch Camry Gracia in Japan.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Tuesday it would launch Camry Gracia station wagon and sedan models in Japan next Monday.
The company has set monthly sales targets of 4,000 wagons and 2,000 sedans, Toyota president Hiroshi Okuda said.
The sedan will sell for about 2.19 million yen and the wagon for about 2.28 million yen.
The Camry Gracia station wagon is the successor to the Scepter station wagon which was made by Toyota Motor Manufacturing Kentucky Inc (TMMK) in the United States.
TMMK stopped making the Scepter in June because of poor demand in the United States.

The Camry Gracia station wagon is made in Japan. Toyota started exporting the sedan model in September to the United States, Europe and Asia at a monthly rate of just under 10,000 units, but has no plans to export the wagon model.
